findings.claim: The manifest ownership check does not enforce the requirement that review roles own only findings paths.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 'Write ownership is disjoint' states: 'Review roles SHALL own only a findings path.' The added `ownershipProblems` function only checks `owns.length === 0` and pairwise `globsOverlap(a, b)`, with no validation that `fhir-code-reviewer`, `fhir-security-compliance-reviewer`, or `fhir-conformance-validator` own only `.agent-team/findings/...`.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend `ownershipProblems` or add a separate check that identifies review/gate roles and rejects any `owns` entry outside `.agent-team/findings/<role>/**`; add a seeded failing test.

findings.claim: The recorded manifest-build test evidence is stale and no longer matches the committed test file.
findings.evidence: The evidence row says `node --test scripts/agent-team/build-manifest.test.mjs` produced `10/10 pass`, but `scripts/agent-team/build-manifest.test.mjs` now contains 14 `test(...)` cases, including the later native-wrapper, harness-tool, owns-statement, and list-parser tests.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-run the test command and update the evidence file with the actual current node:test summary.
